# @neural-ng/core/password

- Import canonical `NeuralPassword` from `@neural-ng/core/password`.
  `PasswordComponent` is a compatibility alias only.
- Bind the string model with `[(value)]`, `[formField]`, `[formControl]`, or
  `[(ngModel)]`.
- `autocomplete` defaults to `current-password`; use `new-password` only for
  account creation or password reset.
- `toggleVisibility` defaults to true. `showFeedback` defaults to false.
- Strength feedback is presentational and must not replace schema/server
  validation.
- Use `unstyled` or global unstyled mode for headless rendering. Structural
  classes remain; typed `classes` and direct class inputs own visuals.
- The visibility control uses Neural Icons `nt-eye` and `nt-eye-off` by
  default. Override with `showIconClass` and `hideIconClass`.
- `touch` emits on native input blur. The component supports `focus()`,
  `select()`, and `reset()`.
